trigger: Player reaches the outer door of the master rendering vault in Room 06.

lines.speaker: intern-bunty
lines.text: Sir! The global broadcast goes live in nine minutes! Do you have the drive?!

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: BEIGE encrypted the vault partition! We can't locate the raw file, dost!

lines.speaker: brahmansh
lines.text: Wait! Look at frame 4,092! It's cycling at 23.976 fps! That's a dropped frame!

lines.speaker: brahmansh
lines.text: GG thaa 🔫! That glitch is our uncompressed backup partition! Right there!

lines.speaker: mishthi
lines.text: Here, hot chai and bandages for everyone. As if I care... just stay alive.

lines.speaker: manvi
lines.text: Whatcha doin, Mishthi? Classic caretaking in deep denial! Love you, girl!

lines.speaker: mishthi
lines.text: As if I care, Manvi. Ashwath, hack the lock before I sigh into the void.
